template.title: The Grocery Mission
template.summary: A brave child follows a list to find items in the supermarket, learns to make good choices, and feels proud of their independence.

sentences.text_with_blanks: [[slot_child]] walked into the bright supermarket with a small basket, ready for a new adventure.
[[slot_parent]] gave [[slot_child]] a list with two items: [[slot_item1]] and [[slot_item2]], and said, "Find them in the next aisle, and bring them back."
[[slot_child]] nodded, then headed toward the cereal aisle, where the boxes were stacked so high they looked like a wall of colorful bricks.
[[slot_child]] looked for the brand [[slot_brand]] on the [[slot_item1]] box, but the label was missing.
[[slot_child]] thought hard, then chose a similar box that smelled sweet and looked friendly.
Next, [[slot_child]] searched for [[slot_item2]] and found a fresh box of the same brand.
[[slot_child]] felt proud, collected both items, and carried them back to the cart.
When [[slot_parent]] saw the basket, they smiled and said, "Great job, [[slot_child]]! You did a wonderful job picking the best choices."
[[slot_child]] beamed, feeling very brave and independent.
The day ended with a happy snack, and [[slot_child]] dreamed of the next small adventure.
